verdict.rationale: Chronicle documents its own API and SDKs in five languages that share the same resources. The API reference shows programmatic creation of worlds and runs, agent registration, trace ingestion and querying ('in Timeline or through the SDK'), and a CI key scope, so much of the UI workflow is reachable by API. However, nothing states that the API matches everything the UI can do, and no OpenAPI spec was found to verify coverage. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, API coverage of UI-only actions such as 'Add trace' to task and Worldsmith world-building, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
